name: Auto-categorize Google Drive files into folders using AI with Google Sheets logging

parameters.content:
## Auto-categorize Google Drive files into folders using AI with Google Sheets logging

### How it works

This workflow periodically scans a configured Google Drive source folder, uses file metadata and extracted content to classify each file with an AI service, then moves the file into an appropriate category folder. It records every processing outcome in Google Sheets, handles low-confidence classifications with review notifications, and sends run-level or workflow-level alerts when errors occur. A separate scheduled path builds and sends a daily summary from the processing log.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Drive credentials with permission to list, download, create folders, and move files in the source and destination folders.
- Configure Google Sheets credentials and create the processing log spreadsheet/sheet referenced by LOG_SPREADSHEET_ID and LOG_SHEET_NAME.
- Set SOURCE_FOLDER_ID, DESTINATION_ROOT_FOLDER_ID, LOG_SPREADSHEET_ID, LOG_SHEET_NAME, and the AI endpoint/API details in the configuration node.
- Configure Slack credentials/channels and email/SMTP settings for review, daily summary, run error, and workflow failure notifications.
- Enable the schedules and ensure the workflow error trigger is registered as the error workflow for the main workflow if using n8n error handling.

### Customization

Adjust the AI prompt/categories, confidence threshold, duplicate-name strategy, polling and daily-summary schedules, supported file extractors, and notification recipients to match the folder taxonomy and review process.

## Load run configuration

Starts from the polling or daily-summary schedules, loads folder and logging settings, reads the existing processing log, and routes either to daily summary generation or normal file processing.

## Deliver daily summary

Builds a daily summary from logged processing activity and sends it through Slack and email.

## Select source files

Lists files in the configured Google Drive source folder, filters them against the processing log, and starts batch iteration over files to process.

## Detect extraction need

Determines each file's type and decides whether content extraction is needed before AI classification.

## Download and route

Downloads files that need content extraction and routes them to the appropriate extractor based on file type.

## Extract standard documents

Extracts content from common PDF, spreadsheet, and plain-text file formats.

## Extract Office archives

Prepares Office files as archives, unzips them, and parses their XML content for classification text.

## Encode image content

Encodes image files so they can be sent to the AI classifier or vision-capable model.

## Normalize extracted content

Standardizes extracted content from all extractor branches and provides a fallback path when extraction fails or produces limited data.

## Prepare AI classification

Builds the AI request payload from metadata and extracted content, then calls the configured classifier endpoint.

## Parse AI result

Parses the AI response and checks whether the classifier returned valid JSON.

## Repair invalid AI JSON

Retries malformed AI output through a repair request and parses the repaired response for downstream validation.

## Handle AI failures

Applies the AI failure policy and decides whether the file should be retried later or continue with a fallback classification path.

## Validate classification confidence

Validates the final classification result, routes by confidence, and flags uncertain files for manual review.

## Locate category folder

Prepares a Google Drive folder lookup, searches for the target category folder, and checks whether it already exists.

## Create category folder

Creates a missing category folder and re-checks Drive to confirm or retrieve the created folder record.

## Resolve folder id

Consolidates the found or newly created category folder into the destination folder ID used for moving the file.

## Handle duplicate names

Checks for existing files with the same name in the destination folder, determines the duplicate strategy, and decides whether to skip the current file.

## Move approved file

Moves non-skipped files into the resolved category folder in Google Drive.

## Build outcome records

Creates the processing log entry for success, skip, review, or error outcomes, with a nearby error handler for recoverable failures from prior Drive operations.

## Write processing log

Passes the completed log record into Google Sheets and appends it to the processing log.

## Notify reviewers and loop

Determines whether review notification is needed, sends Slack and email notices for flagged files, and advances the batch loop to the next file.

## Send run error summary

After the file loop completes, builds a run summary and sends a Slack alert if the run had processing errors.

## Workflow failure alert

Handles workflow-level failures by formatting the error details and sending a Slack failure alert.

nodes.name: Set Configuration Variables
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for every folder ID, threshold and switch. Edit values here only.

assignments.name: CATEGORY_TAXONOMY
assignments.value: ["Invoices", "Contracts", "Legal", "Finance", "Tax", "HR", "Resumes", "Identity Documents", "Proposals", "Reports", "Meeting Notes", "Project Documents", "Technical Documentation", "Architecture & Technical", "Source Code", "Marketing", "Sales", "Customer Documents", "Presentations", "Spreadsheets", "Images", "Videos", "Audio", "Personal", "Other", "Uncategorized"]

nodes.name: Read Logs from Sheets
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Sheets OAuth2 API. The log is the authoritative processing state.

nodes.name: Fetch Google Drive Files
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API (predefined credential type). Uses the Drive REST API directly; see README section 'Why HTTP Request for some Drive calls'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ='{{ $('Set Configuration Variables').first().json.SOURCE_FOLDER_ID }}' in parents and trashed = false and mimeType != 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder'

parameters.name: fields
parameters.value: nextPageToken, files(id, name, mimeType, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, webViewLink, parents, owners(displayName, emailAddress))

nodes.name: Loop Over Drive Files
nodes.notes: Batch size MUST stay 1: each file is fully processed (incl. folder creation) before the next, which keeps folder creation idempotent and lets nodes reference $('...').first().

nodes.name: Download Google Drive File
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API. Google Docs/Sheets/Slides/Drawings are exported (txt/csv/pptx/png).

nodes.name: Send Data to AI Classifier
nodes.notes: Credential: Header Auth  (Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY). Works with any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint.

nodes.name: 17r - AI Repair Retry
nodes.notes: Credential: same Header Auth as 15. One repair attempt for invalid JSON.

nodes.name: 21 - Find Category Folder
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API (predefined credential type). Uses the Drive REST API directly; see README section 'Why HTTP Request for some Drive calls'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =name = '{{ $json.folderNameQuery }}' and '{{ $('Set Configuration Variables').first().json.DESTINATION_ROOT_FOLDER_ID }}' in parents and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false

nodes.name: 23 - Create Category Folder
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API. Works for My Drive and Shared Drives (parent is the destination root ID).

nodes.name: 23b - Re-check Category Folder
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API (predefined credential type). Uses the Drive REST API directly; see README section 'Why HTTP Request for some Drive calls'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =name = '{{ $('20 - Prepare Destination Lookup').first().json.folderNameQuery }}' and '{{ $('Set Configuration Variables').first().json.DESTINATION_ROOT_FOLDER_ID }}' in parents and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false

nodes.name: 25 - Check Duplicate Name
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API (predefined credential type). Uses the Drive REST API directly; see README section 'Why HTTP Request for some Drive calls'.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: =name = '{{ $json.fileNameQuery }}' and '{{ $json.destinationFolderId }}' in parents and trashed = false

nodes.name: 28 - Move File
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Drive OAuth2 API. files.update with addParents/removeParents moves the file in place (same file ID, content, revisions and sharing) and applies a duplicate-rename in the same atomic call.

nodes.name: 31 - Log Entry
nodes.notes: Convergence point for success / skip / error rows. Referenced by later nodes.

nodes.name: 32 - Write Processing Log
nodes.notes: Credential: Google Sheets OAuth2 API. Auto-maps the log entry keys to the sheet header row.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $('31 - Log Entry').first().json.requiresReview === true && $('Set Configuration Variables').first().json.NOTIFY_ON_REVIEW === true }}

nodes.name: 34 - Send Review Notification (Slack)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding a Slack credential. Disabled nodes pass data through.

nodes.name: 35 - Send Review Notification (Email)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding an SMTP credential.

parameters.subject: =File requires classification review: {{ $('31 - Log Entry').first().json.fileName }}

nodes.name: 36 - Next File
nodes.notes: Restores the log entry (notification nodes replace the item) and returns to the loop.

nodes.name: 39 - Send Run Error Alert (Slack)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding a Slack credential.

nodes.name: D2 - Send Daily Summary (Slack)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding a Slack credential.

nodes.name: D3 - Send Daily Summary (Email)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding an SMTP credential.

parameters.subject: =Google Drive Organization Summary - {{ $('D1 - Build Daily Summary').first().json.date }}

nodes.name: E0 - Workflow Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when an execution of a workflow that names this workflow as its Error Workflow fails (Workflow Settings > Error Workflow).

nodes.name: E2 - Send Failure Alert (Slack)
nodes.notes: OPTIONAL. Enable after adding a Slack credential. Channel is literal because config is not loaded on this path.
